annotations.title: Generate GovCon RMF, Continuous ATO (cATO), SSP & POA&M Package

description: Transform RFP cybersecurity clauses, system architecture descriptions, and cloud hosting baselines into a NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 / DoDI 8510.01 RMF / FedRAMP / StateRAMP Authority to Operate (ATO & Continuous ATO) package with FIPS 199 / CNSSI 1253 security categorization, System Security Plan (SSP) control inheritance matrices, eMASS/CSAM-ready Plan of Action & Milestones (POA&M) schedules, Continuous Monitoring (ConMon) DevSecOps blueprints, and Shipley proposal narratives. This is a read-only, stateless generative authorization modeling call (requires X-RapidAPI-Key; `system_architecture_and_rfp_cyber_text` accepts 40 to 100,000 characters, `cloud_hosting_and_inherited_controls_context` accepts 20 to 80,000 characters, and `target_authorization_framework` and `target_impact_level` calibrate control baselines across DoD RMF IL2-IL6, FedRAMP, StateRAMP, and CMMC 2.0). Use this tool when building System Security Plans (SSPs), eMASS POA&M items, FIPS 199 categorizations, or cATO roadmaps for an ATO boundary; use `answer_security_questionnaire` instead to answer vendor security questionnaires and calculate a numeric DoD SPRS score (-203 to 110), or `scan_far_dfars_clauses` to audit FAR/DFARS solicitation clauses.

cloud_hosting_and_inherited_controls_con.description: Cloud Service Provider (CSP) enclave (AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, GCP Assured Workloads, on-prem), platform layer (Kubernetes, Platform One BigBang, Serverless), and existing security tooling (SIEM, SOAR, ICAM, SAST/DAST).

system_architecture_and_rfp_cyber_text.description: Raw RFP Section C/L/M cybersecurity & ATO requirements, target system architecture, data types processed (CUI, CDI, ITAR, PHI, PII, CJIS), user communities, and interconnection boundaries (40 to 100,000 characters).

target_authorization_framework.description: Target authorization framework: 'dod_rmf_dodi_8510_01_cato' (default DoD RMF & Continuous ATO), 'fedramp_rev5_agency_ato' (Civilian Federal Agency ATO / FedRAMP Rev 5), 'stateramp_txramp_govramp' (State SLED StateRAMP / TX-RAMP / GovRAMP), or 'nist_800_171_cmmc_level_2' (CMMC 2.0 Level 2).

target_impact_level.description: Target DoD Cloud Computing SRG Impact Level or FIPS 199 baseline: 'IL2_LOW', 'IL4_MODERATE_CUI', 'IL5_CUI_NSS' (default), 'IL6_CLASSIFIED_HIGH', 'FEDRAMP_MODERATE', or 'FEDRAMP_HIGH'.

name: generate_ato_rmf_package

authorization_boundary_summary.description: Executive summary of the system authorization boundary, hosting enclave, and target ATO pathway.

continuous_ato_conmon_blueprint.description: Continuous ATO (cATO) DevSecOps pipeline gates, OSCAL automation, and ConMon cadence.

control_inheritance_summary.description: Estimated breakdown of Inherited CSP Controls vs. Hybrid Shared Controls vs. Customer-Implemented Controls.

emass_poam_remediation_schedule.description: eMASS / CSAM-ready POA&M entries with CAT I/II/III severity, compensating controls, and milestones.

fips_199_security_categorization.description: FIPS 199 & CNSSI 1253 Confidentiality/Integrity/Availability categorization and overall high-water mark.

ssp_control_implementation_matrix.description: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 SSP control family implementation narratives, STIG mappings, and audit artifacts.

title: Generate GovCon RMF, Continuous ATO (cATO), SSP & POA&M Package
